name: List group
summary: Rows of related items in one bordered box, plain or with avatars, meta and actions.
description: Use it for short lists people scan: invoices, team members, settings sections. For many columns of data that people compare, use a table.

classes.name: v-list
classes.description: The bordered box on a <ul>, <ol> or <div>, with a rule between rows.

classes.name: v-list-item
classes.description: One row. Put it on the <li>, or on an <a> or <button> inside the <li> to make the whole row clickable.

classes.name: v-list-body
classes.description: The main text block, which grows to fill the row.

classes.name: v-list-meta
classes.description: A second, smaller line under the title.

classes.name: v-list-end
classes.description: Actions, badges or meta pushed to the end of the row.

classes.name: v-list-plain
classes.description: No box: rows are separated by rules only.

states.description: On a linked row: tinted, with an accent bar at the start, for the current item.

keyboard.action: Moves between linked rows and any buttons in the rows.
Follows a linked row, or presses a button row.

a11y: Use <ul> or <ol> so screen readers announce the number of items.
Wrap a list of navigation links in <nav aria-label> and mark the current one with aria-current="page".
The current row shows a start bar as well as a tint, so it does not rest on colour; in forced colours the bar uses Highlight.
Do not put buttons inside a linked row; give the row a separate action in .v-list-end instead.
